facts.text: Canada and more than two dozen countries signed a joint statement condemning Iran's violent attacks and lethal plotting
Joint statement recognizes UK attribution of Iran's involvement in Sept. 27 RAF Fairford incident
Seven men arrested in RAF Fairford probe; all released on bail, none charged
Advance voting opened for Alberta's 10-question referendum ahead of Oct. 19 vote
Premier Danielle Smith hopes Albertans vote yes to first nine questions for leverage with Ottawa
Belleville synagogue shooter Sean Ward had no firearms licence, per police source
Canadian cybersecurity executive arrested in U.S. in connection with ShinyHunters hack of FBI data
Arrested man named as Edward Dubrovsky; charged with conspiracy to extort and interference with commerce by threats
Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand to travel to India and UAE Oct. 13-16
Canada signed Law of the Sea pledge opposing fees or tolls on international straits

missed.text: Iran has denied involvement in the RAF Fairford plot
Signatories of the Iran statement include the US, France, Germany and Australia
Referendum has nine questions on immigration and the Constitution and a tenth on starting the legal process for a binding separation referendum
Prof. Grace Skogstad told Global News the results 'will be difficult to interpret' and the province lacks authority on some constitutional questions
PM Mark Carney, in a Thanksgiving message from Alberta, said separation would be a 'long, uncertain process'
Ward died after a shootout with police; Const. Jeff Smith was shot in the head; no worshippers were injured
RCMP and Belleville Police declined to discuss Ward's firearms or licensing status, citing the ongoing investigation
A 54-year-old Edward Dubrovsky was detained in Philadelphia and appeared in court last Thursday, per U.S. records
FBI Director Kash Patel confirmed the arrest on social media Friday
